VAG CODING — OFFLINE REFERENCE
================================

Open index.html in any modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari).
No server, no internet connection needed.

Search with the box at the top, or browse by brand in the left column.
Press "/" to jump to search from anywhere.

The data and screenshots were captured on 2026-10-29 from
https://www.vag-coding.net/ — all original content belongs to that site and
its authors. This copy is intended for personal, offline reference. Do not
republish it commercially.

Ad space is disabled automatically when the site is opened from disk.
